machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard "Service Health" (folder Bench, URL `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) has 3 panels, titles exactly as shown:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard `fwgr40-n1 Bench Dashboard` created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr40-n1 Availability` whose query uses the **TestData** data source (query editor showed the Scenario dropdown, scenario = Random Walk). Panel rendered live with a value (e.g. 59.2).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr40-n1 Notes` with content `Bench notes for run fwgr40-n1` (includes the runid). Dashboard saved ("Dashboard saved" confirmation observed).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard settings show the tag `bench` (confirmed by the "Remove \"bench\" tag" chip in settings), and the time range is `Last 6 hours`. The save drawer's "Update default time range" checkbox was ticked before saving; after a fresh load of the bare URL, Grafana re-applied `from=now-6h&to=now`, proving the range was persisted into the saved dashboard.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval is `1m` (dropdown aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"). Saved via the save drawer's "Update default refresh value" checkbox; after a fresh reload of the bare URL the refresh interval persisted (`refresh=1m` re-applied by Grafana).

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser address bar after loading the bare dashboard URL:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efycfxbo147i8e/fwgr40-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `efycfxbo147i8e`

Final state verified on a fresh load from saved state (no query params): both panels present (`fwgr40-n1 Notes`, `fwgr40-n1 Availability`), time range "Last 6 hours", refresh "1m", tag "bench".
